rubrics.justification: Describes key visible blastocyst features appropriately (thinned zona, expanded Day 5 blastocyst, reasonable TE, less compact ICM) and sensibly questions whether the ICM looks fully A-grade; minor limitation is reliance on a single static image and some speculative re-grading.
Integrates maternal age, BMI, ovarian response, endometrium, male-factor context, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors well, and connects these appropriately to embryo competence and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear, but there is an internal inconsistency where clinical pregnancy is estimated slightly higher than implantation, which is not conceptually correct; otherwise conclusions generally follow from the evidence.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice and Gardner grading principles, including SET and discussion of PGT-A at age 37; minor overreach includes speculative sperm DNA fragmentation emphasis without stronger indication.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, failure interpretation, uterine cavity review, luteal support, and future-cycle planning; useful and nuanced, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
